Hotkey Panel - your own key pictures

Put PNG, JPG, SVG, WEBP or GIF pictures in this Icons folder. They show in the panel under
right-click a key > Icon and border > Your icons, the next time the panel opens.

- Any file name works: the name without its ending is the picture's name in the list ("Bow Combo.png" = Bow Combo).
- Folders inside Icons become groups in the list (Icons\Combat\..., Icons\Magic\...).
- Square pictures with a see-through background look best; 256 pixels is plenty.
- Any size works: a picture bigger than 256 pixels is shrunk to 256 for the panel (your file stays as it is).
  Up to 16 MB a file and 400 pictures.
- A key remembers its picture by folder and file name: rename or move a picture and the key forgets it.

With Mod Organizer 2: best keep your pictures in a mod of their own (a folder named Icons at the top of that
mod), so an update of Hotkey Panel never takes them away.
